zh.title: ADS-B 觀測到 Airbus A330-300 抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）
zh.summary: 公開觀測顯示 9M-XXD 號 A330-300 抵達桃園機場
body: 根據公開 ADS-B 航空觀測數據顯示，一架型號為 Airbus A330-300（ICAO 機型代碼為 A333）之廣體航機，於 UTC 時間 2026 年 8 月 12 日 08 時 02 分 52 秒確認抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE；ICAO 機場代碼：RCTP）。該架航機之國籍標誌暨登記號碼為 9M-XXD，於本次觀測過程中運作之無線電呼號為 XAX378。

在資料來源與數據比對方面，本站監測系統主要擷取自 Airplanes.live 之公開廣播式自動監視廣播數據，並由第二資料來源 ADSB.lol 完成資料對照。整體資料交叉確認狀態標示為由雙來源交叉確認（confirmed_by_two_sources）。本次觀測紀錄中，監測系統共計錄得 2 筆有效觀測資料，首次記錄到該航空器有效訊號之時間點為 UTC 時間 2026 年 8 月 12 日 06 時 41 分 54 秒。
關於航空器技術參數與營運者識別資訊，該架 Airbus A330-300 航機之 ICAO 24 位元十六進位定位位址（ICAO hex）為 7501e8。在營運者相關欄位部分，公開觀測資料顯示其營運者 ICAO 代碼為 XAX，但其營運者 IATA 代碼、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱以及營運者所屬國家或地區於系統資料庫中皆標示為未識別狀態。
在抵達判定機制與系統統計背景方面，本站監測系統係依據該航空器已進入臺灣桃園國際機場之地理圍欄範圍內，且氣壓高度參數（alt_baro）顯示為地面（ground），據此判定為確認抵達（confirmed_arrival）。此外，依據本站系統統計說明，在系統觀測歷史累積中，目前尚無可供比較的長期統計數據，本次觀測事件之系統追蹤識別碼為 fw-b578fbb931029e45。

en.title: ADS-B Data Tracks Airbus A330-300 Arrival at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE)
en.summary: Public ADS-B data recorded an Airbus A330-300 landing at Taoyuan International Airport on August 12.
body: According to public ADS-B flight observation data, an Airbus A330-300 aircraft bearing ICAO model code A333 was confirmed to have arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) (ICAO code: RCTP) at 08:02:52 UTC on August 12, 2026. The aircraft involved in this tracking event carries the registration number 9M-XXD and operated under the radio callsign XAX378 during the observed flight sequence.

Regarding data collection and source cross-verification, the flight tracking event was captured using primary observational data from Airplanes.live and cross-verified against a secondary data feed provided by ADSB.lol. The cross-confirmation status is officially categorized as confirmed by two sources (confirmed_by_two_sources). The monitoring system recorded a total of 2 valid observation data points for this flight track, with the first valid signal timestamp registered at 06:41:54 UTC on August 12, 2026.

In terms of aircraft technical parameters and operator identification details, the Airbus A330-300 holds an ICAO 24-bit transponder hex code of 7501e8. The public observation record indicates an operator ICAO designator of XAX; however, the corresponding operator IATA code, operator official name, Chinese translated name, and operator country or region of registry remain unidentified within the current tracking database.

The operational arrival determination was established based on telemetry confirming that the aircraft was positioned within the geographic geofence of Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport while its barometric altitude parameter registered as ground (alt_baro ground). The event is cataloged under system tracking identifier fw-b578fbb931029e45. Furthermore, system statistical notes indicate that there are currently no comparable long-term historical statistics available within the observation cumulative database.
